gen-comfortaa-gf-catamaran: Catamaran sets curvy, unclamped letters with a friendly, approachable ease. And Comfortaa, the display heading, keeps its curves tubular right through the shoulders, where Catamaran lets its strokes thin a little.
gen-comfortaa-gf-chiron-hei-hk: Modern and quietly businesslike, Chiron Hei HK leaves its c open like a bracelet pulled apart beneath Comfortaa's wire-like display letters. Over a long passage it reads smoothly, a plain sans doing its job.
gen-comfortaa-gf-commissioner: Comfortaa draws its heading as if bent from neon tube, with a ring-shaped c and spacing stretched like an uncoiled spring. Commissioner, a sans-serif, handles the smooth reading.
gen-comfortaa-gf-dotgothic16: Neon tubes meet pixel dots here. Comfortaa's heading would lose its stretched, ringlike charm if made small, while DotGothic16 as a plain sans would feel oversized if enlarged for body.
gen-comfortaa-gf-doto: Doto leaves wide margins of space around each glyph, and its round letters get generous mouths. Doto, a plain sans, sits quietly beneath Comfortaa, whose strokes look cut from wire.
gen-comfortaa-gf-el-messiri: El Messiri brings a modest thick-thin shift to its round letters, with a wide slot between the c's two ends. El Messiri then runs a longer passage with clean, modern steadiness, while Comfortaa hums above it, soft and featureless.
gen-comfortaa-gf-electrolize: Wire-straight and techy, Comfortaa draws one ruler-constant line while Electrolize opens its c like a pair of pliers. Their sharpest quality is that sans-meets-neon modern feel.
gen-comfortaa-gf-elms-sans: Comfortaa bends its heading letters like neon tube, with a ring-shaped c and loosely stretched spacing. Elms Sans follows in a plain sans with a ballpoint's pressure-free line and a see-through gap in each s.
gen-comfortaa-gf-encode-sans: Encode Sans reads cleanly because its gaps keep c from collapsing into o, a neutral plain sans under thin steel-rod heading letters. Over a long passage it feels steady and unfussy.
gen-comfortaa-gf-encode-sans-expanded: Comfortaa draws every heading stroke without calligraphic thinning. Its strongest quality is a soft tubular hum, with Encode Sans Expanded, a sans, pulling its c tips well apart below.
